description: Closed-loop voice benchmark for Dumpphone (extends voice_intents.json, does not duplicate it: those 15 canonical cases are included here only where noted as mirrored, with ids C01/W01/etc). Expected values are SEMANTIC truth, not current parser output — failures reveal parser bugs. Scoring splits intent accuracy from slot accuracy (contact/message/time/app), so a misheard contact name fails the slot, not the intent. Categories: canonical, formal, informal, elderly (slow, hesitant, kinship phrasing), mishearing (simulated STT errors, incl. the exact mis-spellings Android pt recognisers produce). Contacts fixture is fictional; never use real contacts for Tier C. Messenger is unsupported: those phrases expect MessengerRemoved and must not open an app or send.
